Question: I have been using mintop (its hair tonic used 4 regrowth of hairs) and it contains 95% alcohol. What do u recommend me to continue using it r not to use... N 1more thing while departing should we say. Answer ID: 6565 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1140/1083=D/1429) It is allowable to use hair tonic containing alcohol but if the mentioned alcohol is made of grapes, raisin, dates and dried dates, then even a drop of it is impure. If the aforesaid oil contains such kind of alcohol then it is not pure and it will make the hair and clothes impure; therefore in this case, it is better not to use such oil. However, if the alcohol is made of other things (like potato, wheat etc) other than the above-mentioned four things, then it is pure and lawful to use it externally. If it is not known what alcohol is made of, then it is better to shun form using oil containing alcohol. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
